summary: Reviewed every changed source, schema, documentation and version path. Required deployment has separate frozen permission and target, serial publication process ownership and stable idempotency. Executed raw observation binds commit/version, target and actual package bytes; current finish/approval recheck live state while historical clone reporting validates saved proof. Fixtures cover incorrect live identity, unknown and accepted responses, lost acknowledgements, interrupted finish and packaging, malformed checkpoints, native resume and exactly one deployment effect. Same-agent review hardened checkpoint validation, released-profile/version binding and matching package producer argv. No live production provider was selected. All 349 Linux tests, macOS/Linux make and candidate distribution gates passed.
